approved_draft.what_it_is_not: A real screenshot cropped for brevity, with its meaning intact, is not a forgery. Confusion about which conversation or timeframe an image comes from is common. Different devices and platform updates genuinely produce different formatting of authentic images.

existing_specific_text.short_definition: Fabricated or altered digital images of conversations, messages, or documents presented as authentic proof.
existing_specific_text.expanded_definition: Fabricated or digitally altered images of conversations, messages, or documents, presented as authentic evidence of something that didn't actually happen or wasn't actually said. This differs from Fabricated Evidence broadly in being specifically about the digital-image medium — text message screenshots, edited photos of documents — which can be especially convincing because screenshots are widely treated as straightforward proof.
existing_specific_text.plain_language_summary: In plain terms: fabricated or altered digital images of conversations, messages, or documents presented as authentic proof.

what_it_sounds_like: A screenshot presented as evidence that doesn't match the target's own records of the same conversation.
Formatting inconsistencies that don't match the messaging platform it's claimed to be from.
The alleged conversation contains claims or phrasing that don't match how the target actually communicates.
innocent_or_ordinary_possibilities: Genuine screenshots get cropped for brevity all the time without altering meaning. Confusion about which conversation a screenshot is from is a common, innocent mistake.
common_false_positives: A genuine screenshot that's simply been cropped for brevity, without altering its actual content or meaning.
Legitimate confusion about which specific conversation or timeframe a screenshot is from.
Platform updates or different devices producing genuinely different visual formatting of real screenshots.

Are there technical inconsistencies that don't match the claimed platform or device?
Is there any independent way to verify the screenshot against the original account or platform?
Does the alleged content match how the target actually writes and communicates?
less_concerning_if: The screenshot checks out against independent records and platform-consistent formatting.
more_concerning_if: The content contradicts the target's own records, and there are technical inconsistencies suggesting alteration.

innocent_or_ordinary_possibilities: Genuinely accurate summaries necessarily simplify and can't include everything. People sometimes just describe things in the order they occurred to them, without any strategic arrangement.
common_false_positives: A genuinely accurate summary that necessarily leaves out some detail simply because of length or relevance.
Someone presenting facts in the order they naturally occurred to them, without strategic arrangement.
A person with a genuinely different, honestly-held interpretation of what the same true facts mean.

Is the specific combination of facts unusual, or does it reflect a natural, non-strategic way of describing the situation?
Does the person resist adding relevant context when it's offered, or readily incorporate it?
Would a neutral summary of the same facts, without the specific arrangement, support the same conclusion?
less_concerning_if: The summary holds up even with additional relevant context added.
more_concerning_if: The impression created falls apart once missing context is added, and that context is actively resisted.

The fabricated report surfaces details or a narrative that couldn't be true given the target's actual, verifiable whereabouts or actions.

Does the report's content diverge specifically from what's independently verifiable, or is it a matter of differing interpretation?
Does the person filing the report have a clear motive tied to a specific conflict with the target?
Would the report hold up if independently investigated with full access to the facts?
less_concerning_if: The report reflects a genuine, if disputed, perception rather than fabricated facts.
more_concerning_if: The report contains claims independently verifiable as false, filed with a clear motive.

Is documentation applied evenly to everyone in the relevant context, or specifically concentrated on the target?

Does the volume and detail of documentation seem disproportionate to any legitimate purpose?
less_concerning_if: Documentation is accurate, applied evenly, and the target has been aware of and able to respond to it.
more_concerning_if: Documentation is one-sided, concentrated specifically on the target, and built without their knowledge.

approved_draft.what_it_is_not: Confidentiality and need-to-know structures exist for genuinely good reasons in most organisations. Information silos form naturally in any large family or workplace. Someone who simply did not think to pass something on has partitioned nothing.

existing_specific_text.short_definition: Structuring information so no one person can see the full picture, limiting accountability and oversight.
existing_specific_text.expanded_definition: Structuring information — in a family, workplace, or organization — so that no single person has access to the full picture, which has the effect of limiting anyone's ability to hold the person controlling the information accountable, since no one else can see enough to connect the dots. Each individual piece of information may be shared honestly; the deception lives in how the pieces are kept apart.

what_it_sounds_like: Different people in the same family or organization each have a different, partial understanding of the same situation.
Questions that would require connecting information from multiple sources get deflected or discouraged.
The full picture only becomes visible when, by chance, two people who each have partial information happen to compare notes.
innocent_or_ordinary_possibilities: Legitimate confidentiality and natural information silos exist in most families and organizations without any intent to avoid accountability. Not proactively sharing everything with everyone isn't automatically a control tactic.
common_false_positives: Legitimate confidentiality or need-to-know structures that exist for genuinely appropriate reasons.
Natural information silos that develop in any large family or organization without deliberate intent to prevent accountability.
A person simply not thinking to share information broadly, rather than deliberately withholding it from specific people.
discernment_questions: Is there a legitimate reason for the information to be compartmentalized, or does it seem to specifically prevent accountability?
Does connecting the compartmentalized pieces reveal something the person controlling the information wouldn't want revealed?
Are people actively discouraged from comparing notes, or does that discouragement just happen not to occur?
Would this person be uncomfortable if the full picture were assembled and shared openly?
less_concerning_if: Any compartmentalization has a legitimate, non-accountability-avoiding reason.
more_concerning_if: The compartmentalization specifically prevents anyone from seeing a pattern that would otherwise be concerning, and connecting information is discouraged.

misuse_warning: One example is a signal to examine, not proof of motive, diagnosis, abuse, danger, or character. Do not use this label to attack, shame, threaten, expose, or retaliate against someone.

related_tactics.name: Exaggeration
related_tactics.definition: Absolutes — 'you always', 'you never' — that inflate the claim.

related_tactics.name: Vague Allegations
related_tactics.definition: Referencing unnamed critics or unspecified accusations.

related_tactics.name: Fabricated Evidence
related_tactics.definition: Manufactured screenshots, edited messages, or forged documents presented as proof.

related_tactics.name: Lying
related_tactics.definition: Stating something known to be false in order to deceive.

related_tactics.name: Lying by Omission
related_tactics.definition: Leaving out information necessary for an accurate understanding, without technically stating anything false.

related_tactics.name: Selective Information Sharing
related_tactics.definition: Sharing only the facts that support a preferred narrative while withholding relevant context.

old_safety_signals.note: Old signals were set by a coarse rule. Decide safety_sensitive yourself from the spec; these are hints only.
